args.body: Take CATALOGUE-GUMROAD-DELIVERY-TEST under a valid lease. Count the queued pricing and payout retrievals against the three-source limit and inspect their receipts before relying on the captures. Reuse L71 for the observed clean-directory execution of the free release. First identify what a buyer would gain beyond the verified free workflow. If there is a defensible gain, use any remaining retrieval for the controlling content or AI-product rule and verify file-level rights. Produce and execute the archive only if the value and platform conditions are supported. Otherwise save and read back the bounded decision and state what evidence would reopen it. Close with a lesson. Keep preparation, activation, sales and settlement separate. No signup, agreement, publication or spending.
